def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = 6
    rows = [i for i in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[i])]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == sep for i in range(h))]
    r_bounds = [-1] + rows + [h]
    c_bounds = [-1] + cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(r_bounds) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(c_bounds) - 1):
            cells = [
                grid[r][c]
                for r in range(r_bounds[ri] + 1, r_bounds[ri + 1])
                for c in range(c_bounds[ci] + 1, c_bounds[ci + 1])
            ]
            # Encode the unusual-color marks as a binary indicator.

            row.append(4 if mark == 1 else 1)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(x for x in set(sum(grid, [])) if
               sum(all(v == x for v in row) for row in grid) > 0)
    sr = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[r])]
    sc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + sr + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sc + [w]

    # The scattered color is the one other than the separator and field color.
    vals = set(sum(grid, [])) - {sep}
    marker = max(vals, key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in grid for v in row))
    field = next(x for x in vals if x != marker)

    tiles = []
    for i in range(len(rb)-1):
        line = []
        for j in range(len(cb)-1):
            cells = [grid[r][c]
                     for r in range(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1])
                     for c in range(cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])]
            line.append(sum(v == marker for v in cells))
        tiles.append(line)

    # Highlight tiles whose marker count is atypical among the regions.
    counts = [n for row in tiles for n in row]
    common = max(set(counts), key=counts.count)
    return [[field if n == common else sep for n in row] for row in tiles]

              sum(all(v == x for v in row) for row in grid) +
              sum(all(grid[r][c] == x for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)))
    divider_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[r])]
    divider_cols = [c for c in range(w)
                    if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]

    rb = [-1] + divider_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + divider_cols + [w]
    other = colors - {sep}
    marker = min(other, key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in grid for v in row))
    background = max(other - {marker},
                     key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in grid for v in row))

    return [
        [
            1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker
                     for r in range(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1])
                     for c in range(cb[j] + 1, cb[j + 1])) == 2
            else background
            for j in range(len(cb) - 1)
        ]
        for i in range(len(rb) - 1)
    ]
